notes: Phase 1 written red (ImportError on the absent module), then Phase 2 made it green. One design refinement came from a red test rather than from review: origin_pair was swallowing git-unavailable as if it were no-remote-configured, so a scan that had lost two of its three derived terms was indistinguishable from a clean one. Git absence now propagates to inspect's wrap and surfaces as control-error; a missing remote still returns None, because the directory name still identifies the checkout. tests/test_shadow.py passes unchanged, confirming the plan's claim that the failure wrap dissolves the subprocess-patch interaction the audit's predecessor flagged.
